ends.note: dead end at cemetery association strip
unnamed 50 ft stub south of Kessler Avenue ends at cemetery boundary line
unnamed 50 ft avenue from Vine Street ends at property line

notes: Vine Street runs down the east edge then south-west; its east side is the plate edge, so centres are midway between the west lot line and the plate edge (car tracks lie east of centre). Mitchell Avenue: north side is the plate edge; a stub continues north-east of Mitchell opposite Kessler Avenue (unnamed, plate edge), hence 'cross'. Clinton Springs Lane (west of Vine) and the stub printed 'CLIN.. SPRI..' east of Vine (taken as Clinton Springs Avenue) are offset about 65 px, recorded as two T-junctions. 'GLEN..' stub east of Vine is cut by the plate edge; written Glenwood Avenue as a guess. Frank Court is a 20 ft court that doglegs to Vine. Lauk Avenue (printed LAUK AV., 20 ft north of Juergens) continues unnamed south-east then east to Vine; taken as the same street. '?' at Vine 8765,6436 is a 50 ft avenue printed only 'AVENUE' (no name in view). Bottom avenue printed only 'AVENUE' in view, taken as McAlpin Avenue; it continues east of Vine as an unnamed stub. Kessler Avenue: 50 ft strip through cemetery association land, turns west at 9153,2017 (where an unnamed 50 ft stub continues south), then south and south-west as an 'AVE.' whose name is not printed in the strip; taken as Kessler Avenue throughout. Another unnamed 50 ft strip runs from Parkwood Place's west end south-west to about 9450,2380 without meeting a street; not picked. The wedge between lots 67-75 and lots 2-12 (8780-8990, 5580-6010) is a parcel, not a street.
